methodology: One live run per configuration on the same deterministic 100-ticket fixture. Severity labels are withheld. Correctness is measured against the explicit context policy. Timings include HTTP body reads, SDK retries, and benchmark instrumentation; no warmup or statistical latency claims.
predicate: Most urgent customer issue first. Apply the severity priorities in context. Within the same severity, put the issue affecting more customers first.

context.policy: Order severity from highest to lowest: (1) active loss of revenue from failed payments, (2) users unable to access their accounts, (3) degraded performance with working features, (4) cosmetic issues with working features, (5) documentation requests with nothing broken. Severity always takes precedence over affected customer count. Within the same severity, more affected customers means higher priority.
